workflows.name: Vera 05 · 01 WhatsApp in (router)
workflows.purpose: The one door for WhatsApp. Checks the message is really from Meta, stores it before anything else, answers Meta at once, drops duplicates, and hands each message to WF-02.

nodes.name: WhatsApp verify (GET)
nodes.does: Meta checks the webhook URL once, when it is set up.

nodes.name: Verify token right?
nodes.does: Only our own token passes.

nodes.name: Echo challenge
nodes.does: Meta gets its challenge back.

nodes.name: Reject verify
nodes.does: Wrong token: refused.

nodes.name: WhatsApp events (POST)
nodes.does: Every message and delivery status from Meta arrives here.

nodes.name: Check Meta signature
nodes.does: HMAC of the raw body with the app secret. Anything not signed by Meta stops here.

nodes.name: Signed by Meta?
nodes.does: Pass or refuse.

nodes.name: Reject unsigned
nodes.does: Not from Meta: 401, nothing stored.

nodes.name: Save raw to inbox
nodes.does: The raw body is written first. If anything later breaks, it can be replayed.

nodes.name: Tell Meta: try again
nodes.does: Database down: Meta gets a 500 and redelivers later. Nothing is lost.

nodes.name: Tell Meta: received
nodes.does: Meta gets 200 within a second. Work continues after this.

nodes.name: Split into events
nodes.does: One item per message and per delivery status.

nodes.name: Message or status?
nodes.does: Statuses update what we sent; messages get processed.

nodes.name: Update delivery status
nodes.does: Sent / delivered / read / failed, on our outbound log.

nodes.name: Send failed?
nodes.does: A failed send must not go unnoticed. (A failed send to a reviewer is only logged, so it cannot loop.)

nodes.name: Flag failed send
nodes.does: Goes to the review queue with the error code.

nodes.name: Nothing to do
nodes.does: Empty or unknown event.

nodes.name: Claim message
nodes.does: Insert by WhatsApp message id. Meta can send the same message twice; the second one gets id 0.

nodes.name: First time we see it?
nodes.does: Duplicates stop here.

nodes.name: Duplicate: ignore
nodes.does: Already processed.

nodes.name: Who sent it?
nodes.does: Phone number → contact, role, site. Also restarts the 24-hour window.

nodes.name: Known person?
nodes.does: Only registered contractor, engineer and reviewer numbers are processed.

nodes.name: Log unknown number
nodes.does: Nothing is read from unknown numbers. Vera ops sees the count daily.

nodes.name: Process the message
nodes.does: Hands over to WF-02 and does not wait, so the router stays fast.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 02 Process one message
workflows.purpose: Files one photo, paper, voice note or text against the right checklist line. Deterministic binding first; AI only picks from open lines; unsure answers go back to the sender as buttons or to a person.

nodes.name: From the router
nodes.does: Gets one message id from WF-01.

nodes.name: Load and lock message
nodes.does: Message, sender, site, open lines, our recent prompts. Marked "processing" so a stuck one is found later.

nodes.name: What kind of message?
nodes.does: Photo / PDF / voice, typed text, a button answer, or a location pin.

nodes.name: Get media link
nodes.does: Meta gives a download link valid for 5 minutes.

nodes.name: Download the file
nodes.does: Downloaded at once, before the link expires.

nodes.name: Hash and size check
nodes.does: SHA-256 of the file. Same file already used on another line, or too large: stopped.

nodes.name: File OK?
nodes.does: Reused or oversized files do not get filed.

nodes.name: Explain file problem
nodes.does: Tells the sender why, in one line.

nodes.name: Send file problem
nodes.does: Through WF-09.

nodes.name: Voice note?
nodes.does: Voice is typed out first, so a spoken line code ("LC teen") can bind it.

nodes.name: Transcribe voice (Sarvam)
nodes.does: Hindi / Marathi / Hinglish → text in its own script. English comes in the report.

nodes.name: Add transcript
nodes.does: If transcription failed, the audio is still filed and the report says "listen".

nodes.name: Store in evidence bucket
nodes.does: Encrypted bucket in Mumbai (ap-south-1). Key = hash, so the same file is stored once.

nodes.name: Keep file after upload
nodes.does: Waits for the upload, then carries the original item (with the file) on. Upload failed = never reaches here.

nodes.name: Bind to checklist line
nodes.does: Reply-to-line, code in caption, reply-to-area + number, picked from list. Only if none: AI.

nodes.name: How was it bound?
nodes.does: Bound for sure / AI must choose / ask the sender.

nodes.name: Build classify request
nodes.does: Photo, PDF or voice transcript + the short list of open lines. The answer schema only allows those codes or NONE.

nodes.name: Claude: which line?
nodes.does: AI chooses a line and gives an honest confidence. It never says whether the site is OK.

nodes.name: Confidence gate
nodes.does: ≥ 0.90 with a 0.30 lead: file it. 0.45–0.90: ask the sender. Unreadable, suspicious, refused or malformed: a person. Shadow mode (first sites): never files on its own.

nodes.name: Sure enough?
nodes.does: File it / ask the sender / a person.

nodes.name: Save as unfiled evidence
nodes.does: The file is kept, with no line yet, so the button answer has something to file.

nodes.name: Build confirm buttons
nodes.does: Top 3 lines as one-tap buttons, plus "Something else".

nodes.name: Ask sender to confirm
nodes.does: The answer comes back as a button reply and is applied in one transaction.

nodes.name: Send to review queue
nodes.does: A person files it, usually within the hour. The sender is told it is being checked.

nodes.name: Mark needs a person
nodes.does: Any failed step lands here: download, storage, AI. The message is never dropped.

nodes.name: Is it a paper line?
nodes.does: Papers get read and checked; site photos wait for the engineer.

nodes.name: Build extract request
nodes.does: Asks AI to copy the fields exactly. Null when not printed: never a guess.

nodes.name: Claude: read the paper
nodes.does: Name, address, dates, workers covered, sum insured…

nodes.name: Parse the fields
nodes.does: Anything that is not a clean answer counts as unread.

nodes.name: Check paper rules
nodes.does: Plain code: valid on start? covers peak labour? sum insured ≥ contract? Each check says why.

nodes.name: Make reply fragment
nodes.does: One line for the reply: accepted / sent back (with why) / filed.

nodes.name: Save evidence and line
nodes.does: Evidence row + line status + audit entry, in one statement. Never overwrites the engineer's own decision.

nodes.name: Queue the reply
nodes.does: WF-05 sends one reply per burst, not one per photo.

nodes.name: Mark done
nodes.does: Finished.

nodes.name: Closes an open item?
nodes.does: Sent as a reply to an open-item reminder.

nodes.name: Propose closure
nodes.does: Item marked "proposed closed" with this photo. Only items of the sender's own site.

nodes.name: Waiting for the engineer?
nodes.does: Already proposed or closed: nothing more to ask.

nodes.name: Build closure ask
nodes.does: Photo + "Accept, close it" / "Not fixed".

nodes.name: Ask engineer to close
nodes.does: WF-11 sends the photo with the buttons. His tap closes the item and the line.

nodes.name: Read typed text
nodes.does: "status", "baki kya hai", "LC-10 NA creche not needed", or a remark.

nodes.name: Which command?
nodes.does: Small, fixed set of commands. Anything else is a remark.

nodes.name: Send the gap list now
nodes.does: Same list as 7 PM, on demand.

nodes.name: Build help text
nodes.does: Two lines of help (reviewers and unknown line codes get their own line).

nodes.name: Send help
nodes.does: Through WF-09.

nodes.name: Build N/A request
nodes.does: Only the engineer can mark a line N/A.

nodes.name: Ask engineer about N/A
nodes.does: Engineer decides with one tap. The contractor hears the answer.

nodes.name: Save remark
nodes.does: Kept against the site; shown to the engineer.

nodes.name: Read button answer
nodes.does: The button id says what it is: bind / pick / na / close / sign. Role checked: only the engineer can sign.

nodes.name: Allowed?
nodes.does: Wrong role or unknown button: refused.

nodes.name: "Show me" tapped?
nodes.does: The generic template's button: send what was held while their 24-hour window was closed.

nodes.name: Release held messages
nodes.does: Everything held for this person in the last 7 days, once.

nodes.name: Anything held?
nodes.does: Nothing held: nothing to send.

nodes.name: Send held message
nodes.does: Now inside the window, so the real message (buttons, photo, PDF) goes out.

nodes.name: Apply answer
nodes.does: One database transaction, with an audit entry. Checks the person belongs to the site the button is about.

nodes.name: Paper to re-read?
nodes.does: A paper filed by a button has not been read yet.

nodes.name: Re-read the paper
nodes.does: WF-10 reads it and runs the paper checks, as if it had been bound at once.

nodes.name: Save location pin
nodes.does: A pin sent as a reply to an area prompt becomes a 30 m circle for that area. The engineer can redraw it.

nodes.name: Build "what we accept"
nodes.does: Unsupported types get a polite line, not silence.

nodes.name: Send "what we accept"
nodes.does: Through WF-09.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 03 Walk page API
workflows.purpose: Back end for the engineer's phone page on the visit day: load the checklist, take each capture (photo + GPS + status + voice), record the GPS trail, mark areas, record QR sticker scans, print stickers, finish the walk.

nodes.name: Walk page opens (GET)
nodes.does: The page asks for this site's checklist.

nodes.name: Check walk link
nodes.does: Signed link, expires the day after the visit.

nodes.name: Link valid?
nodes.does: Forwarded or expired links stop here.

nodes.name: Respond 401
nodes.does: Clear message for the page.

nodes.name: Load checklist for walk
nodes.does: Lines, statuses, papers already accepted, and the drawn areas.

nodes.name: Send checklist
nodes.does: The page caches it, so it works with no signal.

nodes.name: Walk page posts (POST)
nodes.does: capture / trail / finish / zone / spot / stickers (body.action). The page retries until it gets an answer.

nodes.name: Check walk link
nodes.does: Same check.

nodes.name: Link valid?
nodes.does: Forwarded or expired links stop here.

nodes.name: Respond 401
nodes.does: Page shows "ask for a new link".

nodes.name: Which action?
nodes.does: Six kinds of post.

nodes.name: Load walk
nodes.does: Lines, areas, and whether this capture was already saved.

nodes.name: Validate capture
nodes.does: UUID per capture, known line code, size limits, sane GPS, phone clock vs server clock.

nodes.name: Capture valid?
nodes.does: Bad input gets a 400 with the reasons.

nodes.name: Respond 400
nodes.does: The page shows the reason and keeps the capture.

nodes.name: Already saved?
nodes.does: Same capture_id = a retry from a weak network. Answer as before, save nothing twice.

nodes.name: Respond saved (again)
nodes.does: Idempotent answer.

nodes.name: Place on site map
nodes.does: Phone fix (with its own ± metres) against the area drawn for this line: in / edge / out / unknown. A sticker of this area scanned just before counts as in. Never blocks the capture.

nodes.name: Photo to file
nodes.does: Base64 from the page → a file.

nodes.name: Store walk photo
nodes.does: Same bucket as WhatsApp evidence.

nodes.name: Respond: try again
nodes.does: Storage down: the page keeps the capture and retries.

nodes.name: Save capture and line
nodes.does: The line was chosen before the shutter: binding is certain. Status is the engineer's own.

nodes.name: Respond saved
nodes.does: The page shows "inside Labour camp" or "38 m outside: are you in the right area?"

nodes.name: Voice remark attached?
nodes.does: Voice is transcribed after the page has its answer.

nodes.name: Voice to file
nodes.does: Base64 → audio file.

nodes.name: Transcribe remark
nodes.does: Original words kept; English comes in the report.

nodes.name: Save remark transcript
nodes.does: If transcription failed, the report says so.

nodes.name: Save trail points
nodes.does: Batches of GPS points every 20 s while the page is open. Duplicates ignored.

nodes.name: Respond 204
nodes.does: No body.

nodes.name: Mark walk finished
nodes.does: Once only.

nodes.name: Respond 202
nodes.does: The page can close.

nodes.name: Draft the NOC report
nodes.does: WF-06 runs in the background.

nodes.name: Areas for marking
nodes.does: Which areas this site has.

nodes.name: Check the area shape
nodes.does: Known area, 3–30 corners or a 5–150 m circle, GPS ±30 m or better, a sane size.

nodes.name: Shape OK?
nodes.does: Bad shapes get a 400 with the reasons.

nodes.name: Save area shape
nodes.does: The engineer's shape replaces the contractor's pin for that area. The old one stays in the audit log.

nodes.name: Respond area saved
nodes.does: The page draws it at once.

nodes.name: Respond bad shape
nodes.does: The page says why (usually: GPS too weak, wait and try again).

nodes.name: Check sticker
nodes.does: The code is signed: a made-up or altered code fails here.

nodes.name: Sticker genuine?
nodes.does: Only signed codes count.

nodes.name: Record sticker scan
nodes.does: Kept with time and GPS. A sticker from another site records nothing.

nodes.name: Respond sticker
nodes.does: The page switches to that area.

nodes.name: Respond bad sticker
nodes.does: Refused.

nodes.name: Areas for stickers
nodes.does: The areas walked on this site.

nodes.name: Sign sticker codes
nodes.does: One signed code per sticker (default 4 per area).

nodes.name: Respond stickers
nodes.does: The page prints them as QR codes, A4.

nodes.name: Respond 500
nodes.does: Any step that breaks still answers the page, so it keeps the capture and retries.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 04 Evening gap list
workflows.purpose: 7 PM, three days before the visit until the day before: what is still missing goes to the contractor, and a one-line readiness note goes to the engineer.

nodes.name: Every evening 7 PM
nodes.does: IST (instance timezone Asia/Kolkata).

nodes.name: On demand (status)
nodes.does: When the contractor types "status".

nodes.name: Sites in paper-check window
nodes.does: Every site whose visit is in the next 3 days (or the one that asked).

nodes.name: One site at a time
nodes.does: A failure on one site does not stop the others.

nodes.name: Build gap list
nodes.does: Missing papers by severity, what was sent back and why, how many site photos so far.

nodes.name: Send to contractor
nodes.does: Free inside 24 h of their last message; otherwise the approved utility template.

nodes.name: Tell the engineer
nodes.does: "Ready to travel" or the list of critical papers still open.

nodes.name: All sites done
nodes.does: End of run.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 05 One reply per burst
workflows.purpose: Contractors send 20 photos in a minute. Instead of 20 replies, Vera waits until the burst goes quiet for 90 seconds and sends one summary.

nodes.name: Every minute
nodes.does: Small, cheap query.

nodes.name: Bursts that went quiet
nodes.does: Claims each burst once, so two runs never send the same reply.

nodes.name: Compose one reply
nodes.does: "✅ Accepted PAP-03. ↩️ PAP-04 sent back: sum insured below contract value. Still open: 6."

nodes.name: Send the reply
nodes.does: Through WF-09.

nodes.name: Mark reply sent
nodes.does: Done.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 06 NOC report draft
workflows.purpose: When the walk ends: code scores the checklist and decides the recommendation; AI only words the engineer's remarks in English; the wording is checked; a PDF goes to the engineer to sign with one tap.

nodes.name: When the walk is finished
nodes.does: From WF-03.

nodes.name: Every night 9 PM (safety net)
nodes.does: Catches a walk the engineer forgot to finish.

nodes.name: Walks with no report
nodes.does: Today's visits without a draft.

nodes.name: Load the visit
nodes.does: Every line, photo count, transcript, GPS fix and area.

nodes.name: Which areas were walked
nodes.does: An area counts as walked only with GPS fixes inside it (allowing for each fix's own error), or a sticker scanned there.

nodes.name: Score the visit
nodes.does: Recommendation by rule: any critical open or an area not walked → not ready; majors open → ready with conditions.

nodes.name: Build wording request
nodes.does: Remarks + open items, already decided. AI is told not to decide anything.

nodes.name: Claude: word the observations
nodes.does: Hindi / Marathi remarks → plain English observations, citing line codes.

nodes.name: Check the wording
nodes.does: Only known line codes, no verdict words. If it fails, the engineer's own transcripts go in instead.

nodes.name: Build report page
nodes.does: Recommendation, open items with due dates, areas walked, observations. Says which parts AI wrote.

nodes.name: Page to file
nodes.does: index.html for the PDF service.

nodes.name: HTML to PDF (Gotenberg)
nodes.does: Self-hosted, next to n8n. No report leaves our servers to be printed.

nodes.name: Upload PDF to WhatsApp
nodes.does: The PDF goes to WhatsApp as a media file: there is never a public link to the report.

nodes.name: Both done
nodes.does: Waits for the bucket copy and the WhatsApp upload; carries the media id on.

nodes.name: Store report PDF
nodes.does: Versioned: a re-draft never overwrites a signed report.

nodes.name: Save NOC draft
nodes.does: Draft saved.

nodes.name: Create open items
nodes.does: Each open line becomes a dated item for WF-07.

nodes.name: Build sign-off message
nodes.does: PDF + Approve / With conditions / Hold buttons.

nodes.name: Send to engineer to sign
nodes.does: The button reply from his own number is the sign-off, kept with its WhatsApp id. The NOC is never issued without it.

nodes.name: Alert: report failed
nodes.does: Vera ops sends it by hand; the engineer is not left waiting.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 07 Open items after the visit
workflows.purpose: Every morning: reminders for items due, escalation for critical items overdue. The contractor replies to the reminder with a photo; the engineer approves it from the photo, not another visit.

nodes.name: Every morning 9 AM
nodes.does: IST.

nodes.name: Items due or overdue
nodes.does: Only items that are due.

nodes.name: Each item
nodes.does: One at a time.

nodes.name: Reminder or escalate?
nodes.does: Critical and overdue → the project head hears about it.

nodes.name: Remind the contractor
nodes.does: Sent as a message they can reply to: the reply binds to this item for sure.

nodes.name: Escalate?
nodes.does: Only critical items, only when overdue.

nodes.name: Tell the project head
nodes.does: One line with the item and days overdue.

nodes.name: All reminders sent
nodes.does: End of run.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 08 Set up a new site
workflows.purpose: The engineer (or planning) fills one form: site, contractor, dates, contract value, peak labour, phones. Vera creates the checklist, sends the contractor the area prompts, and sends the engineer his walk link.

nodes.name: New site form
nodes.does: An n8n form behind login. No spreadsheet to keep in sync.

nodes.name: Read the form
nodes.does: Labels → field names.

nodes.name: Check the form
nodes.does: Dates in order, numbers are numbers, phones have country code.

nodes.name: Form OK?
nodes.does: Wrong input stops here, with reasons.

nodes.name: Show what is wrong
nodes.does: The form shows the error.

nodes.name: Copy checklist for this site
nodes.does: Template mob-v1: only the lines that apply (plant or RMC, crane, creche, excavation).

nodes.name: Create site, lines, contacts
nodes.does: All in one statement: either the whole site is created or nothing is.

nodes.name: Build area prompts
nodes.does: One message per area, each listing its lines by number.

nodes.name: Send area prompts
nodes.does: The first one goes as the welcome template (outside the 24 h window); the contractor's reply opens the window for the rest.

nodes.name: Sign the walk link
nodes.does: Signed link for the engineer, valid until the day after the visit.

nodes.name: Send engineer the walk link
nodes.does: Through WF-09.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 09 Send on WhatsApp
workflows.purpose: The only way Vera sends anything. Picks session message or template by the 24-hour window, logs every message id (so replies bind to lines), backs off on rate limits, and never fails silently.

nodes.name: Asked to send
nodes.does: Who, what, and why (kind / area / line).

nodes.name: Load contact and window
nodes.does: Phone and when they last wrote to us.

nodes.name: Session or template?
nodes.does: Inside 24 h of their last message: the message itself. Outside: its approved template; or, for buttons, photos and the NOC, one generic template with a "Show me" button while the real message is held.

nodes.name: Can send?
nodes.does: No phone, or outside the window with no template: not sent, logged.

nodes.name: Log not sent
nodes.does: Shows up in the daily ops list.

nodes.name: Send to WhatsApp
nodes.does: Graph API messages endpoint.

nodes.name: Log what we sent
nodes.does: The message id is what makes "reply to this message" bind for sure. A held message is kept here until they tap "Show me".

nodes.name: Why did it fail?
nodes.does: Reads the WhatsApp error code: rate limit, window closed, bad number.

nodes.name: Retry?
nodes.does: Rate limit → wait and retry (max 3). Window closed → template. Bad number → a person.

nodes.name: Wait 30 s
nodes.does: WhatsApp limits how fast one person can be messaged.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 10 Read and check a paper
workflows.purpose: A paper filed by a button tap (sender or reviewer) has not been read yet. This reads it from the bucket and runs the same paper checks as WF-02, so no paper is accepted without them.

nodes.name: Paper filed by a button
nodes.does: From WF-02 after a confirm or review answer.

nodes.name: Load the paper
nodes.does: The file, its line and the site facts.

nodes.name: Get it from the bucket
nodes.does: The stored copy, by its hash key.

nodes.name: File with its details
nodes.does: One item: file + line + site.

nodes.name: Build extract request
nodes.does: Same request as WF-02: copy the fields exactly, null when not printed.

nodes.name: Claude: read the paper
nodes.does: Name, address, dates, workers covered, sum insured…

nodes.name: Parse the fields
nodes.does: Anything that is not a clean answer counts as unread.

nodes.name: Check paper rules
nodes.does: Plain code, same rules as WF-02. Each check says why.

nodes.name: Make reply fragment
nodes.does: Accepted / sent back (with why) / being checked.

nodes.name: Save the checks
nodes.does: Checks on the evidence, status on the line, a review item if a person must look. Never overwrites the engineer's decision.

nodes.name: Sender known?
nodes.does: Files sent by a contractor get a reply; nothing to reply to otherwise.

nodes.name: Queue the reply
nodes.does: Goes out with the next burst reply (WF-05).

nodes.name: Send to review queue
nodes.does: Bucket or AI failed: a person checks the paper. It stays filed on its line.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 11 Show a file with buttons
workflows.purpose: Sends a stored photo or paper to one person with answer buttons: the engineer approving a fixed item, a Vera reviewer filing an item. The file is uploaded to WhatsApp as media, so no public link to evidence ever exists.

nodes.name: Asked to show
nodes.does: Who, which file, what text and which buttons.

nodes.name: Has a file?
nodes.does: Some review items have no file (a failed download).

nodes.name: Find the file
nodes.does: Where it is stored.

nodes.name: Get the file
nodes.does: From the evidence bucket.

nodes.name: Upload to WhatsApp
nodes.does: Media id, valid 30 days. Nothing public.

nodes.name: Build the message
nodes.does: Picture + up to 3 buttons, or the picture then a list. If the file could not be fetched, the text and buttons still go.

nodes.name: Send it
nodes.does: Through WF-09: outside the 24-hour window it is held behind a "Show me" template.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 12 Review queue on WhatsApp
workflows.purpose: Every 5 minutes, new review items go to a Vera reviewer on WhatsApp with the file and one-tap answers: which line, accept / send back a paper, ask to send again, or handled. Answers come back through WF-02.

nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.does: Small query.

nodes.name: Hand out new items
nodes.does: Each item to one reviewer (round robin), claimed once. No reviewer on file: items wait.

nodes.name: Build review message
nodes.does: Unfiled file: pick the line. Paper to check: accept / send back. No file: ask to resend / handled.

nodes.name: Show it to the reviewer
nodes.does: WF-11 sends the file with the answers.

workflows.name: Vera 05 · 00 Errors and stuck messages
workflows.purpose: Catch-all for every Desk 05 workflow. Logs the failure, emails Vera ops (a different channel from WhatsApp, so a WhatsApp outage cannot hide itself), and every 10 minutes sends messages stuck in "processing" to the review queue.

nodes.name: When any workflow fails
nodes.does: Set as the error workflow on WF-01 to WF-12.

nodes.name: Describe the failure
nodes.does: Workflow, node, error, link. No message contents, no secrets.

nodes.name: Log the error
nodes.does: Kept even if email fails.

nodes.name: Email Vera ops
nodes.does: Email, not WhatsApp: a WhatsApp outage must not hide its own alert.

nodes.name: Every 10 minutes
nodes.does: Sweeper.

nodes.name: Messages stuck in processing
nodes.does: A crash between nodes still ends with a person looking at the message.
